name: When is a stone retaining wall necessary?

mainEntity.name: When is a stone retaining wall necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: A stone retaining wall becomes necessary when managing significant elevation changes on your property, preventing soil erosion, or creating level areas on a slope. If your landscape has a steep grade, poor drainage leading to runoff, or if you plan to install a patio, garden, or walkway on uneven ground, a retaining wall can provide essential structural support and land stabilization. It also protects foundations and other structures from soil movement.
acceptedAnswer.description: A stone retaining wall is necessary for managing elevation changes, preventing soil erosion, or creating level areas on sloped terrain for landscaping or construction.
